question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Sacred cow
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"sacred cow"** refers to something that is considered immune from criticism or questioning. (अविवेचनीय)

 
 
• **Example: **The national health service is a** sacred cow i**n many countries, and any attempts to reform it are met with strong resistance.
 
 
 
• **"Unquestionable" **means something that cannot be doubted or disputed. (अविवादित)
 
 
• **Example: **Her loyalty to the company is **unquestionable.**
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the meaning of the idiom **'sacred cow' **is **'unquestionable'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Interrogate **(पूछताछ करना): To ask questions formally and systematically.

 
 
• **Example:** The police had to** interrogate **the suspect for several hours.
 
 
 
• **Harmful **(हानिकारक ): Causing or likely to cause harm.
 
 
• **Example: **Smoking is **harmful **to your health.
 
 
 
• **Hateful **(घृणास्पद): Arousing, deserving of, or filled with hatred.
 
 
• **Example:** His **hateful **comments were condemned by everyone in the room.
